title: A proof of the mod 4 Kawauchi Conjecture
summary: Kawauchi conjectured that the Conway polynomial of an amphicheiral knot factors as $\nabla_K(z)=f(z)f(-z)$ for some integer polynomial $f(z)$. In joint work with Hartley, he showed this was true for strongly amphicheiral knots, and Hartley used the JSJ decomposition of the knot exterior to generalize to all negative amphicheiral knots. Ermotti--Hongler--Weber were the first to publish a counterexample to the general case.
